description: The plot illustrates the training loss over a number of iterations for six different model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks spaced every 0.1 units. All six configurations are represented by solid lines without markers, each surrounded by a lighter shaded region of the same color, and all exhibit a similar overall trajectory: starting above the y-axis maximum of 3.4 at iteration 0, declining sharply until approximately 40000 iterations, and then gradually increasing through the end of the x-axis. The purple line, representing "Vanilla," reaches the lowest minimum of approximately 2.7 near 40000 iterations and ends at roughly 2.8 at 140000 iterations. The light blue line, representing "StrmLLM (n=64)," reaches the highest minimum of approximately 2.85 near 40000 iterations and ends at roughly 2.95. The orange line ("SepLLM (n=64)"), green line ("SepLLM (n=64, H)"), and dark blue line ("SepLLM (n=128)") follow nearly identical paths, reaching a minimum of approximately 2.75 near 40000 iterations and ending at roughly 2.85 at 140000 iterations. Finally, the red line, representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," reaches a minimum of approximately 2.7 near 40000 iterations, remaining slightly above the purple line, and ends at roughly 2.8 at 140000 iterations.
